questions.question: The _________ of a firm is a relationship between inputs used and output produced by the firm.
questions.solution: In economics, a production function relates physical output of a production process to physical inputs or factors of production. It is a mathematical function that relates the maximum amount of output that can be obtained from a given number of inputs - generally capital and labor.

questions.question: ________ means that the President of India can refer any matter that is of public importance or that which involves interpretation of Constitution to Supreme Court for advice.
questions.solution: The Advisory Jurisdiction of the Court invoked through Presidential References, is governed by Article 143 of the Constitution. Under Article 143 of the Constitution of India, the President is empowered to refer to the Supreme Court any matter of law or fact.

questions.question: There are total _________ parliamentary seats (Rajya Sabha constituency) in Tripura.
questions.solution: Total two members have been elected to the 16th Lok Sabha from Tripura. There is only one member from Tripura in the Rajya Sabha.

questions.question: During their rule the British persuaded or forced cultivators in Assam to grow ________.
questions.solution: During their rule, the British persuaded or forced cultivators in various parts of India to produce other crops: jute in Bengal, tea in Assam, sugarcane in the United Provinces (now Uttar Pradesh), wheat in Punjab, cotton in Maharashtra and Punjab, rice in Madras.

questions.question: The Chola kingdom mostly ruled which region of India?
questions.solution: The Chola dynasty was one of the longest - ruling dynasties in the history of southern India. The earliest datable references to this Tamil dynasty are in inscriptions from the 3rd century BCE left by Ashoka, of the Maurya Empire.

questions.question: In due course of time the meander loop cuts off from the river and forms a cut - off lake, also called a/an _________ lake.
questions.solution: An oxbow lake is a U - shaped body of water that forms when a wide meander from the main stem of a river is cut off, creating a free - standing body of water. This landform is so named for its distinctive curved shape, resembling the bow pin of an oxbow.

questions.question: The oceanic crust mainly consists of silica and __________.
questions.solution: Earth's crust comes in two varieties, continental and oceanic. Continental crust is silica - rich, or felsic. Oceanic crust is mafic, relatively rich in iron and magnesium.

questions.question: Order Primata comprising monkey, gorilla and gibbon is placed in class Mammalia along with order Carnivora that includes?
questions.solution: Carnivora is a diverse order that includes over 280 species of placental mammals. Its members are formally referred to as carnivorans, i.e. meat - eating organisms. The order includes tiger, cats, dogs, wolf, bears, raccoons, etc.

questions.question: In roots, the protoxylem lies towards periphery and metaxylem lies towards the centre. Such arrangement of primary xylem is called __________.
questions.solution: In roots, the protoxylem lies towards periphery and metaxylem lies towards the centre. Such arrangement of primary xylem is called exarch. In stems, the protoxylem lies towards the centre and the metaxylem lies towards the periphery of the organ. This type of primary xylem is called endarch.

questions.question: Which is the only one example of Mollusca Phylum?
questions.solution: Locust, butterfly and scorpion belong to Arthropoda phylum.

questions.question: If the speed of an object moving along a straight line keeps changing, its motion is said to be _________.
questions.solution: A body is said to be in uniform motion if it travels equal distances in equal intervals of time. A body is said to have non - uniform motion if it travels unequal distances in equal intervals of time.

questions.question: The substances which reduce friction are called _________.
questions.solution: • A lubricant is a substance, usually organic, introduced to reduce friction between surfaces in mutual contact, which ultimately reduces the heat generated when the surfaces move.

questions.question: Notepad is a text editor in which of the following operating systems?
questions.solution: Notepad is a simple text editor for Microsoft Windows and a basic text - editing program which enables computer users to create documents.

questions.question: Magnesium oxide (MgO) + Water (H₂O) = ?
questions.solution: Magnesium oxide reacts with water to produce magnesium hydroxide (Mg(OH)₂).

questions.question: What is the unit of calorific value?
questions.solution: Calorific value refers to the amount of energy produced by the complete combustion of a material or fuel. It is measured in units of energy per amount of material, e.g. kJ/kg.

questions.concept: Science Technology and Inventions, Ecology and Environment
questions.question: According to Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB), particulate size ________ micrometres or less in diameter are responsible for causing the greatest harm to human health.
questions.solution: Fine particulate matter (PM2.5) is an air pollutant that is a concern for people's health when levels in air are high, since its particles are so small that they can enter and accumulate in lungs.

questions.question: _________ scheme launched by the Central Government is a special social security scheme which includes Pension and Life Insurance.

options.text: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana

questions.solution: Mahatma Gandhi Pravasi Suraksha Yojana is a special social security scheme which includes Pension and Life Insurance, introduced by Ministry of Overseas Indian Affairs for the overseas Indian workers in possession of Emigration Check Required (ECR) passports.

questions.question: Who invented Space Pen?
questions.solution: Space pen is a ballpoint pen invented by Paul C. Fisher and made to work in zero gravity, underwater, and at any angle (even upside down). It is also known as Zero Gravity Pen and Fisher Space Pen and it is sold by Fisher Space Pen Company.

questions.question: Who was the 2015 Men's Rugby World Cup Runner - Up?
questions.solution: The 2015 Rugby World Cup was held in England on 31st October, 2015 between reigning champions New Zealand and their rivals Australia. New Zealand emerged the winner.

questions.question: Group of Monuments at Hampi was built by?
questions.solution: Hampi (Karnataka, India) is home to a group of monuments recognised as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. They were built by rulers Harihara and Bukkaraya on the banks of the Tungabhadra River.

questions.question: Which of the following won the Best Feature Film Award at the 64th National Film Awards held in the year 2017?
questions.solution: The 64th National Film Awards was an award ceremony to honour the best films of 2016 in the Indian cinema, held on 3 May 2017. Marathi film Kaasav was named the Best Feature Film of 2016.

questions.question:
Which of the statements given below are correct?

1. The author of the novel 'Fellside' is Victor LaValle.

2. The author of the novel 'A Head Full of Ghosts' is M.R. Carey.

3. The author of the novel 'Brave New World' is Aldous Huxley.
questions.solution: The author of the novel ‘Fellside’ is Mike Carey and the author of the novel ‘A Head Full of Ghosts’ is Paul Tremblay.

questions.question: Which county was in the first rank in the 2016 Human Development Index published by the United Nations Development Programme?
questions.solution: The Human Development Index was unveiled as part of the Human Development Report (HDR) 2016 titled ‘Human Development for Everyone’ published by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP). Norway got the first spot, followed by Australia and Switzerland.

questions.question: Name the estuary on the border of India and Pakistan?
questions.solution:
Sir Creek is a 96 km (60 mi) tidal estuary on the border of India and Pakistan. The creek, which opens up into the Arabian Sea, divides the Gujarat state of India from the Sindh province of Pakistan.

questions.question: Select the correct option: Convert decimal 101 to binary
questions.solution:
To convert 101 into binary:

Step 1: divide (101)₁₀ successively by 2 until the quotient is 0:

101/2 = 50, remainder is 1, 50/2 = 25, remainder is 0

25/2 = 12, remainder is 1, 12/2 = 6, remainder is 0

6/2 = 3, remainder is 0, 3/2 = 1, remainder is 1, 1/2 = 0, remainder is 1

Step 2: Read from bottom (MSB) to top (LSB) as 1100101. This is the binary equivalent of decimal number 101.
